meta.title: Ridgeline Pocket
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from source/README.md and source/brand-notes.md: the brand fixes the palette, the grid, the font and the step rate, so the tone pass had little to decide.

source.notes: app README: offline maps, trail cards, elevation, summit check-ins, battery; one example trail with numbers
four greens exactly, 240x135 grid at whole-number scale, 5x7 bitmap type, 9-fps steps, LCD ghosting

rationale.palette: The brand allows exactly four greens (shadow #1B2B1A, moss #3E5E2E, lichen #8FAE3A, paper #D4E59A) and forbids a fifth; gradients become ordered dithering between two neighbours.
rationale.type: Its own 5x7 bitmap font, uppercase, tabular numbers, drawn pixel by pixel in code (modules/pocket.js); no anti-aliasing anywhere.
rationale.motion: Everything steps at 9 fps on the 108-BPM grid (a beat is exactly 5 steps). The LCD keeps a faint ghost of the previous step. No smooth zooms; scrolling moves whole pixels.
rationale.sound: Soft square-wave chiptune at 108 BPM in G major: pulse arps, a stepped triangle bass, a pulse lead and quiet noise drums, never loud ('a pocket toy, not a dashboard').
rationale.visuals: A trail told in four screens: power-on, the side-scrolling trail with live distance and climb, the offline map drawing the route, the summit check-in.
